events.text: asks for a refill on their blood pressure medication
I can help with that, but first, could you please provide your name and date of birth to verify your identity?
corrects themselves mid-sentence, it is actually the thyroid one, levothyroxine
I still need your name and date of birth to verify your identity before proceeding with the refill for levothyroxine.
I've submitted a refill request for your levothyroxine 75mcg at CVS. If you need anything else, just let me know!
asks for it to go to a Walgreens instead of the CVS on file
I can update your preferred pharmacy to Walgreens, but I need to verify the specific location. Could you please provide the address of the Walgreens you'd like to use?
the Walgreens on Main Street, not the one on 5th Avenue
I've updated your preferred pharmacy to Walgreens at 418 Main St. Would you like me to resubmit the refill request for levothyroxine there?
You're welcome! Have a great day!
